note:
_devoverunt se dicentes_ (v. 12) – they vowed by saying (…). Note that _devotio_ – used only v. 14 in the Vulgate – means “cursing, curse,” like _devotatio_ (1 Kgs 8:38). – Literature:
1957. Jean Chatillon: Devotio. In: _Dictionnaire de Spiritualité_. Tome 3. Paris (1884 cols.), cols. 703– 710, esp. cols. 705–706. According to Chatillon, meant is not just a vow or promise (as a superficial reading would suggest), but something more serious and powerful; see the Douay version’s “they bound themselves under a curse” (to kill the apostle Paul, v. 12), Knox’s “they bound themselves under a solemn curse,” or Allioli’s “sie verschworen sich unter Verwünschungen.”
